newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM plans to launch TSR rubber futures contract.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM plans to launch TSR rubber futures contract.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday it plans to list a futures contract for Technically Specified Rubber (TSR) 20, hopefully sometime during the business year starting on April 1.
The move reflects an increase in Japan's imports of TSR rubber in recent years, backed by relatively cheap prices compared with Ribbed Smoked Sheet (RSS) rubber.

"We aim to decide on the listing policy by April this year. And we hope that the exchange will be able to launch the TSR rubber futures contract sometime during the next business year," a TOCOM official said.

The current rubber futures contract listed on TOCOM and the Kobe Rubber Exchange is Thai benchmark Ribbed Smoked sheet (RSS) 3. The official said TOCOM has not yet decided whether the contract will be yen-based or dollar-based.
Japan's TSR rubber imports in the first nine months of 1996 accounted for 37 percent of the total rubber imports, up from 32 percent in 1995, according to the Rubber Trade Association of Japan.
The TOCOM official said the exchange expected Japan's demand for TSR rubber to continue to grow.
